cd /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip && git add packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/routes/plugins.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(deploy-cloudflare): implement full plugin REST API surface

Adds CF-native handlers for all plugin routes that the UI calls:

DB-derived (read directly from Hyperdrive):
  GET    /api/plugins/:pluginId
  GET    /api/plugins/:pluginId/health
  GET    /api/plugins/:pluginId/config
  GET    /api/plugins/:pluginId/jobs
  GET    /api/plugins/:pluginId/jobs/:jobId/runs
  GET    /api/plugins/:pluginId/dashboard

Process-dependent (proxied to sidecar):
  DELETE /api/plugins/:pluginId
  POST   /api/plugins/:pluginId/{enable,disable,upgrade}
  GET    /api/plugins/:pluginId/logs
  POST   /api/plugins/:pluginId/config
  POST   /api/plugins/:pluginId/config/test
  POST   /api/plugins/:pluginId/jobs/:jobId/trigger
  POST   /api/plugins/:pluginId/webhooks/:endpointKey
  POST   /api/plugins/:pluginId/{bridge/data, bridge/action, data/:key, actions/:key}
  GET    /api/plugins/:pluginId/bridge/stream/:channel
  GET    /api/plugins/tools
  POST   /api/plugins/tools/execute

Why: previously only list/install/examples/ui-contributions were implemented;
visiting a plugin's detail page in the UI returned 501 for /:pluginId and
/:pluginId/dashboard. Worker info comes back as null in the dashboard (no
worker process in CF Workers); the sidecar handles lifecycle when present.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
